intro: William's Shipment is a carefully boxed consignment of candles harvested from Elwynn Forest's troublesome kobolds. Packed by William Pestle in Goldshire, it is destined for his brother Morgan's alchemical business in the Stormwind Trade District.

p: The Pestle brothers keep a steady mercantile line open between Goldshire and the capital. While William works out of Elwynn Forest gathering materials from local opportunists and adventurers, Morgan tends to the family storefront, Pestle's Apothecary, in Stormwind's Trade District. Because William cannot leave his own duties to travel north, he relies on couriers to carry this securely packed parcel of wax and candles into the city.

The contents of the shipment are kobold candles, salvaged from the creatures infesting Elwynn's mines. William gathers the large candles for their wax and packs them for his brother Morgan at Pestle's Apothecary. Through William's enterprise, these reclaimed mining scavenges become useful stock for the capital's alchemical trade.
